messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "rhinoceros beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A quadrupedal creature with the furry head, body, legs, paws and short tail of a brown bear combined with glossy dark beetle armor. A long curved black serrated horn like a rhinoceros beetle horn rises from its forehead and arches back over its head. Segmented dark brown-black carapace plates cover its back from the neck to the rump, with large oval elytra-like shields over the shoulders and hips, tan segmented plating on the lower sides, and segmented greave-like armor on the legs. It stands in side profile facing right on four clawed bear paws.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "furry brown bear head with tan muzzle, black nose, and dark eyes", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the creature facing right"}, {"looks_like": "long glossy black curved horn with notched inner edge like a rhinoceros beetle horn", "part": "horn", "where": "on the forehead between the eyes arching up and back"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded furry brown bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head behind the horn"}, {"looks_like": "thick furry brown bear legs", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in back"}, {"looks_like": "broad furry bear paws with long pale claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs"}, {"looks_like": "short furry brown bear tail", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark brown-black segmented beetle carapace with a large spiked shoulder shield and four rear segments", "part": "shell", "where": "covering the back from the neck to the rump"}, {"looks_like": "large glossy dark brown oval elytra-like plates", "part": "plates", "where": "on the sides over the shoulders and hips"}, {"looks_like": "tan ribbed segmented plating with a row of oval openings along the top edge", "part": "plates", "where": "on the lower sides and belly beneath the dark dorsal shell"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark brown segmented greave-like armor, spiked on the front legs", "part": "plates", "where": "on the front and outer surfaces of all four legs"}, {"looks_like": "shaggy medium-brown bear fur with lighter tan on the muzzle and underside", "part": "fur", "where": "covering the head, neck, legs, rear and underside where not covered by shell"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
